Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL3436042. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay CHEMBL3436042, and join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort the result set by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
